items.why: Black Friday banner replaces the launch banner; sale prices cut while list prices stay the same.

promo.text: Black Friday: save up to 40% on ON1 Photo RAW 2027 and add-ons until Nov 27

items.why: The Next plan price in the comparison table is replaced by "Sob Consulta" (on request).
CGM health-program subscription prices (sensors plus coaching), not software; PricingSaaS also shows the current page above the reported after-prices, so the numbers are unstable.
Free plan workflow limit cut from up to 20 workflows to up to 5 workflows.

record.short: Free plan workflow limit cut from up to 20 workflows to up to 5 workflows.

items.why: Enterprise (custom pricing, SSO/SAML) and the medical/legal plans no longer appear on the individual pricing page; only Free, Premium and Business remain.

record.short: The Enterprise plan and the medical/legal industry plans are removed from the individual pricing page; only Free, Premium and Business remain.

items.why: Black Friday price on the Basic 2-year plan cut from $3.49/mo to $2.99/mo; Complete and Prime unchanged.

promo.text: Black Friday: Basic 2-year plan $2.99/mo, was $3.49/mo, up to 74% off

items.why: NEXT Scale no longer lists a Dedicated Onboarding Team; this is a service item, not a software feature or price.
The $129 Departure entry plan is removed; Takeoff at $169 is now the lowest tier.

record.short: The $129 Newswire Departure entry plan is removed, so the cheapest tier is now Takeoff at $169.

items.why: Amazon dropped from the Recognize reward catalog and charitable giving added; content change, no price or plan effect.
Unlimited plan API line reworded to API Standard and a separate API Pro tier is mentioned; no price or existing allowance is shown changing.
A new Model APIs per-token price table for 12 open-weight models appears; prices are shown for the first time and no existing price changes.
Free plan saved reports cap lifted from 5 per seat to Unlimited; custom properties go from Not available to Limited.

record.short: Free plan saved reports limit raised from 5 per seat to Unlimited, and custom properties move from Not available to Limited.

items.why: Three models added to the MindsHub catalog and the unversioned Claude Haiku entry dropped; no existing price changes. The Muse Ember listing is the same change first seen on Nov 11.
Email security tiers renamed Critical/Advanced/Premium to Core/Pro/Max with new product cards; no prices are shown, so this is a rename and repositioning.
Limited-time 30% site-wide promo: Microsoft 365 Personal $99.99 → $69.99 and Premium $199.99 → $139.99 for the first year; Family unaffected.

promo.text: 30% off first year: Microsoft 365 Personal $69.99 (was $99.99), Premium $139.99 (was $199.99)

items.why: The public 5% ticket fee and the plan cards are removed; buyers are told to confirm fees with the team.
Cloud moves from usage-based ($30 base) or resource-based billing to fixed per-instance pricing by region, with a new $0.15/GB outbound bandwidth charge.

record.short: Cloud moves from usage-based billing with a $30 base to fixed per-instance prices (XS $14.88 in US East vs $18), with disk at $0.165/GiB and a new $0.15/GB outbound bandwidth charge.

items.why: A "coming soon" AI MCP Integration link was added to the nav and footer; not tied to a plan or price.
The 24/7 emergency support row is removed from the comparison table for two Control plans; support item only.
The free entry offer changes from a self-serve readiness check to an expert-led security review; a service, with the MSI and Enterprise prices unchanged.
API keys included cut from 2 to 1 on the Free and Basic plans; a customizable dashboard is added to Basic.

record.short: API keys included are cut from 2 to 1 on the Free and Basic plans, while Basic gains a customizable dashboard.

items.why: The annual billing discount on Marketing Platform is trimmed from Save 30% to Save 25%, so annual billing costs more; list prices are not shown changing.

record.short: The annual billing discount badge on the Marketing Platform toggle is cut from Save 30% to Save 25%.

items.why: Office Hours for KeyShot Studio Business is now labeled Americas only and Network Rendering is reworded as an add-on; support and wording, no price shown.
The transaction fee gains a per-loyalty-order charge: Starter 1.0% + 0¢ → 1% + 15¢, Pro 0.75% + 0¢ → 0.75% + 10¢; plan prices unchanged.

record.short: Transaction fees add a per-loyalty-order charge: Starter 1.0% + 0¢ → 1% + 15¢ and Pro 0.75% + 0¢ → 0.75% + 10¢, with plan prices of $99 and $399 unchanged.

items.why: Black Friday promo (Nov 12-27, first 500 customers): Professional $47 → $23/mo and Ultimate $68 → $34/mo on yearly plans.

promo.text: Black Friday Nov 12-27, first 500 customers: 60% off yearly Professional ($23/mo) and Ultimate ($34/mo)

items.why: A sports production calculator shows a $500 per event starting price for the first time.
The Agency/Enterprise card becomes Teams and Enterprise and shows team plans from $49/mo for the first time, replacing Get in touch.
Mid-subscription upgrades (Local to Cloud, Standard to Pro, prorated) are now allowed; no price changes.
The "No credit card required" line is removed from the Free card, hero and FAQ; the free credits offer is unchanged, and no new requirement is shown.
Enterprise moves from custom pricing to a published From $399/mo; the plan bullets are also rewritten.
The "Support in less than 30 seconds" claim is removed from the all-plan features list; a support claim, not a feature or price.
A new banner offers a welcome discount on the first plan to new free sign-ups; plan prices are unchanged.

promo.text: Welcome discount on the first plan for new free sign-ups

items.why: Monthly prices rose on Plus ($8 → $18), Pro ($18 → $38) and Ultra ($188 → $198) while Business fell $88 → $78; Autopilots quotas were added.

record.short: Monthly prices (yearly billing) rise on Plus $8 → $18, Pro $18 → $38 and Ultra $188 → $198, while Business falls $88 → $78.

items.why: Early Black Friday sale: annual Pro $30 → $21/mo and AI $46 → $29/mo, headline up to 50%; Standard unchanged at $15.

promo.text: Early Black Friday sale: annual Pro $21/mo (was $30), AI $29/mo (was $46), up to 50% off

items.why: Black Friday sale of 40% off annual plans through Dec 2 (Starter $15, Professional $29, Boost $59 per month, from $20/$39/$79); the supported model also moves to Claude Sonnet 5.5.

promo.text: Black Friday: 40% off annual plans through Dec 2 (Starter $15/mo, was $20)

items.why: A new Unlimited Company Plan is added with talk-to-us pricing and $12K first-year onboarding, then a flat annual fee.

record.short: New Unlimited Company Plan with unlimited users, dashboards, Klips and data connections; pricing is Talk to us, with $12K first-year onboarding, then a flat annual fee.

items.why: Black Friday promo for new customers until Dec 1: 50% off 3 months on monthly plans, 3 months off on annual, Agency $284 → $255.

promo.text: Black Friday: 50% off 3 months on monthly plans, Agency $255 (was $284); new customers, ends Dec 1

items.why: SCIM directory sync on Scale goes live (was Coming soon) with 3 directories included and $35 per extra; a new capability, no existing price changes.
Business agent time cut from 120 to 30 hrs/week (10 → 5 agents) and Lite from 30 to 15 hrs/week; a $199 Max plan is added and a Black Friday banner appears (promo not recorded separately).

record.short: Business agent time is cut from 120 to 30 hrs/week (10 → 5 agents) and Lite from 30 to 15 hrs/week, alongside a new Max plan at $199/month.

items.why: A year-end accountant package is added to the single plan's included features; price unchanged.
Starter annual-billed price cut from $14.50 to $11 a month while monthly videos are halved from 10 to 5.

record.short: Starter falls from $14.50 to $11 a month, but monthly videos drop from 10 to 5.

items.why: Workflows and Access Certification rows added to the IAM comparison table; no existing price changed.
Companion AI daily limit 25 to 50 is already recorded as jimdo-2026w47.
A flat supplier-side fee (amount not disclosed) now applies to issuances under 1,000 certificates, alongside the buyer per-tonne fee.

record.short: A flat supplier fee now applies to issuances under 1,000 certificates; the amount is not disclosed.

items.why: Max annual price cut from $250 to $75 per seat a month (50% OFF badge) while monthly credits fall from 8,000 to 5,000; the price had jumped $75 to $250 a week earlier.

record.short: Max annual drops from $250 to $75 per seat a month, but credits fall from 8,000 to 5,000; the price was $75 before the Nov 1 jump to $250, so this may be a discount cycle.

items.why: Bare Metal starting price raised from $90 to $120 a month, after repeated flips between $90 and $100 in recent weeks.

record.short: Bare Metal starting price rises from $90 to $120 a month; the price has flipped repeatedly in recent weeks, so it may not be settled.

items.why: Ecommerce removed from Premium and offered free for 1 year on Unlimited and Cloud Startup.

record.short: Premium loses Ecommerce, which is now free for 1 year on Unlimited and Cloud Startup.

items.why: Professional Voice Clone, previously $29 a month, is now included free on Pro, together with the new Avatar 6 engines.

record.short: Professional Voice Clone, once $29 a month, is now included in Pro.

items.why: Credit-block pricing from $49 a month replaced by five tiers: Starter $99, Plus $199, Team $499, Pro $999, Growth $1,999.

record.short: Credit blocks from $49 a month are replaced by five tiers from $99 to $1,999 a month with bundled credits and agent seats.

items.why: CloudTest Lite and Go starting prices replaced by Contact Sales buttons.
The 10-visitor refund guarantee now starts at first payment instead of trial signup; terms wording, no price or allowance change.
HyperFormula is no longer offered free under open-source GPLv3; it is commercial-only with a trial licence on request.

record.short: HyperFormula is no longer free under GPLv3 and is now commercial-only, with trials on request.

items.why: Business plan bullet renamed from Free viewer seats to Free Lite seats; prices unchanged.
SkillCat Mobile Maintenance Training, a stand-alone purchasable offering, removed from the pricing page.

record.short: SkillCat Mobile Maintenance Training is no longer on the pricing page, with its tab and implementation section.

items.why: Custom member fields added to Publisher plan and comparison table; no price changed.
Unlimited gains 5 hours of tutoring a month and AI tutor calls, and a Free tier is shown; paid prices unchanged.
Starter ($299 a month) is now available to net new vendors only; two new add-ons are listed without prices.

record.short: Starter, still $299 a month, is now restricted to net new vendors with no existing paid G2 subscription.

items.why: Studio-side labels renamed from Pro and Max to Growth and Business; prices unchanged.
Kimi K3.1 Pro added to serverless rates; no existing price changed. The existing record covers Managed Training, a different change.
Fraud Score Smart Signal added as an unpriced Enterprise add-on.
A Free-plan note about scheduled runs being skipped after 250 runs a month was removed; the page does not show whether the limit itself changed.
AWS self-serve compute+storage starting price cut from $0.125 to $0.056 per unit per hour.

record.short: AWS self-serve starting price falls from $0.125 to $0.056 per unit per hour.
